author: NASS
description:
Step back into the Roaring Twenties and discover Paris and Amsterdam as they appeared nearly a century ago. From the grand boulevards of Paris to the historic canals and narrow streets of Amsterdam, this rare footage reveals everyday life, architecture, transportation, and the atmosphere of a changing Europe. Carefully restored in 4K 60fps

📽️ Technologies & Techniques Used:
• Advanced video restoration
• New semantic colorization only for the ambiance (not historically accurate)
• Manually colorized keyframes (to establish accurate ambiance and color consistency (not historically accurate)
• Advanced frame reconstruction to 4K
• Manual color corrections 
• Classical restoration workflows (AviSynth ) combined with modern tools for (60fps, stabilization, denoise, cleaning, and deblurring )
• Sound design created for immersive atmosphere

B&W Video Source: Prelinger Archives,Filecoin Foundation for the Decentralized Web (FFDW) and Internet Archive
